title: Search for Bigfoot
content: Hey! Shrek and Donkey are living in the redwood country of northern California.But where is Bigfoot? It's a mystery. There are lots of rumors, but they're confusing.If I see Bigfoot I will do a drawing of him. Is that Mrs. Bigfoot? With a female like that, the species would never continue.Maybe I should ask this guy.I'm in despair at this point. Perhaps Bigfoot does not exist.Hooray! Jeanette found him.
